children: US logistics services provider's fiscal Q4 revenue grew 18.5% yr/yr
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q4 rose to $0.15, up from $0.10 yr/yr
On August, 7 company completed an amended and restated $200 mln secured credit facility, extending its maturity to 2031
Company expects constructive trends in North American truckload and intermodal markets to support recovery
Company sees ongoing complexity in international trade driving demand for customs brokerage services
Radiant expects cross-border tariff actions to create additional opportunities for Canadian operations
AIRFREIGHT & DISASTER RELIEF - Notable strength in international airfreight operations, driven by disaster relief following typhoon activity in the Western Pacific
NAVEGATE PLATFORM - Domestic Navegate platform cited as a catalyst for growth, providing customers with better visibility and tools to manage complex supply chains
U.S. FORWARDING OPERATIONS - Co said quarter-over-quarter improvement was driven principally by U.S. forwarding operations and contributions from both domestic and international service offerings
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the courier, postal, air freight & land-based logistics peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Radiant Logistics Inc is $10.25, about 26.1% above its September 11 closing price of $8.13
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
